title: cyclobothra pallida
intro: Cyclobothra pallida, commonly known as the "Australian Sandalwood", is a plant species native to Western Australia. This plant is valued for its medicinal and aromatic properties, with reported health benefits including its ability to reduce anxiety and stress, improve sleep quality, and exhibit antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory activities. The therapeutic actions of Cyclobothra pallida include its sedative and analgesic effects, as well as its ability to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include various terpenoids, including santalol and α-santalol, which contribute to its medicinal properties and distinctive aroma.
